title: PAYE expenses and benefits (EXB) submissions: schema 2026 to 2027
text:
Schema and supporting documents for PAYE software developers for 2026 to 2027.

 Test service support from October 2026. Live service from April 2027.

 This page contains year-specific information only. Before starting development to this API, read the PAYE internet, submissions, expenses and benefits: generic specifications .
changeNote: The title has been updated to reflect Expenses and Benefits (EXB) submissions. Information about the generic specifications and the Expenses and Benefits Error Catalogue 2026 to 2027 have been added.
